system.description:
A great billowing darkness pours from your hands and eyes, a cold black mist that destroys all it engulfs. When it withdraws, the bodies of the slain vanish into it, leaving only their belongings behind.

Spend any number of Willpower Traits and concentrate for three turns as the cloud spreads to a 50-pace radius; at the end of the third turn the whole area counts as Shroud of Night. At the start of each of the next three turns, everyone within it that you wish to destroy must win a Static Physical Challenge against the number of Willpower Traits you spent or take three Health Levels of aggravated damage. After the third turn of damage the cloud collapses back into you, and anyone who died within it — from this power or any other source — disappears, leaving only clothes and possessions. You may not invoke this power again for the rest of the night.
system.duration: Three turns, then ends for the night
